message.content: It started about two weeks ago, after I had a cold or chest infection with breathing symptoms. Since then my breathing has gotten steadily worse. Now I get winded with very little activity, like walking a short distance or doing normal things around the house. My legs have been swelling over that same time. I haven't noticed chest pain or dizziness. I'm not sure about the lying flat or waking up at night part, since it wasn't mentioned to me. The belly pain came on during these two weeks along with the leg swelling. I can't tell you more exactly where it is or whether it's related to meals, and I haven't mentioned any belly swelling or weight gain.
